integrity: Standalone exact factor and signature checker included. Finite checks corroborate the unrestricted recurrence proof but do not independently certify the infinite theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Distinct contiguous factors of the binary period-doubling fixed point at lengths 2^k with integer k>=3; no conclusion for non-dyadic lengths, positional frequencies, or higher-order Abelian equivalence. Historical priority remains subject to earlier equivalent results under different terminology.
title: Exact six-class 2-Abelian ambiguity spectrum of dyadic period-doubling factors
